title: Method for preparing zinc-loaded lactoferrin, zinc-loaded lactoferrin, and use thereof
abstract_excerpt: The invention discloses zinc-loaded lactoferrin and its preparation and use. S1 dissolves native lactoferrin powder in purified water, places it in dialysis tubing, dialyzes against iron-removal buffer, and then continues dialysis against purified water. S2 vacuum-freeze-dries the dialysate to obtain iron-depleted lactoferrin powder, dissolves it in binding buffer, and adds zinc sulfate. S3 repeats dialysis against binding buffer and then purified water after binding. S4 vacuum-freeze-dries the dialysate to obtain zinc-loaded lactoferrin powder. ICP-MS reportedly measured zinc at up to 140 mg/100 g and a chelation rate up to 87%.

A method for preparing zinc-loaded lactoferrin, comprising: S1, dissolving native lactoferrin powder in purified water and dialyzing it against an iron-removal buffer and then purified water; S2, vacuum-freeze-drying to obtain iron-depleted lactoferrin powder, dissolving the powder in binding buffer, and adding zinc sulfate; S3, dialyzing the post-binding solution against binding buffer and then purified water; and S4, vacuum-freeze-drying to obtain zinc-loaded lactoferrin powder. _x000D_ 8. title: Buffalo-milk antioxidant peptides and separation and preparation method thereof
abstract_excerpt: Buffalo milk is defatted, adjusted for protein content, pasteurized, temperature- and pH-conditioned, hydrolyzed with a flavor protease, enzyme-inactivated, and cooled. Gel-column separation with detection at 220, 280, and 254 nm yields fractions that are freeze-dried and screened for reducing power and DPPH, hydroxyl-radical, and superoxide-anion scavenging. High-performing fractions are collected as antioxidant peptides.
